oas.pcSay: I long to believe you weave no fate around me.
oas.pcDo: I hold his gaze, my voice trembling with the weight of old oaths.
oas.pcSayRaw: I want to believe you’re not manipulating me.
oas.pcDoRaw: Look him in the eyes, my voice trembling.
oas.liDialogue: You shaped Seren’s wish with nothing but the hunger your eyes draw from every soul present. Did you call to me hoping I would bind you to safety before them all?
oas.liAction: He leans nearer, the Answer’s cold metal pressing between our palms as his stare pins me in place.
